title: Defect-Cavity Bandpass Stack for Enhanced SWIR Transmission
scientific_hypothesis: Introducing a half-wave defect cavity layer in the center of a Bragg stack will create a transmission resonance in the SWIR band (1000-1700 nm) while the surrounding Bragg mirrors maintain high UV reflection (300-450 nm).
design_principle: A defect layer in a photonic bandgap structure creates a localized transmission state within the stopband. By placing the cavity resonance in the SWIR band and designing the mirrors for UV reflection, dual-band performance can be achieved through spatial separation of spectral functions.
proposed_topology: air / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / sio2_substrate
soft_objectives: maximize transmittance peak in 1000-1700 nm band
minimize sideband transmission outside target bands
manufacturing_considerations: Cavity layer requires precise thickness control for resonance positioning
Symmetric mirror design simplifies deposition sequencing
theory_basis: Fabry-Perot cavity resonance in multilayer stacks
expected_advantages: Sharper transmission band in SWIR than broadband approaches
Better spectral selectivity for methane detection band
Mirror sections can be optimized independently for UV reflection
known_risks: Transmission band may be narrower than 1000-1700 nm requirement
Cavity resonance sensitive to thickness errors
May require more layers to achieve sufficient UV reflection with cavity insertion
execution_request_english: Design a 21-layer defect-cavity dielectric coating on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Stack sequence: air / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / SiO2 (Lemarchand)_substrate with layer 11 (hfo2) serving as the central cavity. Optimize 18 mirror layer thicknesses and 1 cavity layer thickness to create a transmission resonance in 1000-1700 nm band while maintaining high reflectance in 300-450 nm band. Use only hfo2 and SiO2 (Lemarchand) materials. Maximum 30 layers constraint satisfied with 21 layers.
